speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four couples, in their colours. A pageant of Worthies falling apart. Everyone laughing. It could end there and be forgotten by Lent.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A man comes in. Black. From her father's court. He says half a line and she ends it for him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A man in black. Half a line. She has the rest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And they don't marry. Not today. A twelvemonth. Let them earn it where we can't see.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Heminges will say it's no ending. …It's the only ending.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Enter a messenger. In black, among all their colours. He needn't say much. The king your father—

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Remember: the frost on the pump tonight, how breath hangs white in the close.
